test_multiindex_drop_full_tuples: test the MultiIndex.drop method to remove full tuple labels like ("foo", "two") from a MultiIndex
test_multiindex_drop_partial_level: test the MultiIndex.drop method to remove partial level labels like "foo" matching all tuples starting with that value
test_multiindex_drop_errors_ignore: test the MultiIndex.drop method with errors="ignore" to suppress KeyError when dropping missing labels
test_multiindex_drop_mixed_partial_full: test the MultiIndex.drop method with mixed partial and full drop labels like ["foo", ("qux", "one")]
test_multiindex_droplevel_by_index: test the MultiIndex.droplevel method to remove levels by integer index or list of indices
test_multiindex_droplevel_by_name: test the MultiIndex.droplevel method to remove levels by name string
test_multiindex_droplevel_empty_list: test the MultiIndex.droplevel method with an empty list to return the original index unchanged
test_multiindex_drop_level_parameter: test the MultiIndex.drop method with the level parameter to drop values from a specific level
test_multiindex_drop_nan_in_index: test the MultiIndex.drop method when NaN values are present in the index
test_multiindex_drop_non_monotonic_dupli: test the MultiIndex.drop method when the index contains non-monotonic duplicate tuples
